name: AZ Flight Training
address: Arizona (city not shown on the home page)
summary: Arizona flight school that posts instructor rates and a minimum-hours private pilot cost example.
differentiator: Its $8,900 private pilot example is the lowest total in this set, but it assumes only the 40-hour FAA minimum, which the page itself says most students exceed.
pricing: Instruction $65 an hour, discovery flight $99 special, Cessna 172 at $135 an hour in its cost example.

aircraft.label: Cessna 172, as used in its cost example
aircraft.note: Appears in the cost example, not in a rate table.

estimate.hoursBasis: the FAA minimum: 40 hours of flight time at $135, 20 hours dual at $65, 15 hours of ground instruction at $65
estimate.note: Not including tax. The page says the average private pilot needs more than 50 hours.

feesNamed: Knowledge test $150 and practical test $750 in its example
bestFor: Students who want the lowest published minimum-hours total.
skipIf: You want a realistic total; add hours to the example.
watchOut: The example uses FAA minimum hours; the page says the average student needs 50 or more.
No rate table; the $135 Cessna 172 figure appears only in the cost example.
